title: Ride out an impulse
summary: Create a little space before choosing what comes next.

delay.title: Give yourself a moment
delay.paragraph1: An impulse does not require an immediate or permanent decision.
delay.paragraph2: Waiting briefly gives you a chance to notice whether its intensity rises, falls, or stays stable.

concrete.title: Change something concrete
concrete.paragraph1: Changing rooms, putting down the phone, or starting a very small task can interrupt an automatic response.
concrete.paragraph2: Choose an action simple enough to remain possible even when your energy is low.

expectations.title: Do not demand disappearance
expectations.paragraph1: A strategy can still be useful when the feeling does not disappear immediately.
expectations.paragraph2: The aim is to practice making a choice, not to achieve a perfect result every time.

reflectionPrompt: Which realistic strategy could you try during the next difficult moment?
